name: Lacuna Atlas
summary:
An atlas of the void.

Lacuna Atlas puts the real universe inside your headset - not an artist's
impression, but the actual sky, built from open astronomical catalogs. Every
star has a real name, spectral class, and true position in space.

Point. Focus. Fly.
Aim at a star to read what it is, then flick forward to glide toward it - it
blooms into a glowing sun as you arrive. Keep going past Sirius and
Betelgeuse, out where constellations shear apart into three dimensions.

Hunt the stars.
Take a star-hunt
